title: Austerity: The History of a Dangerous Idea | Mark Blyth | Talks at Google
summary: Mark Blyth's Talks at Google presentation based on his book on austerity. He argues that government debt came largely from bailing out banks, and that budget cuts are a misguided response to the financial crisis.
why: HN commenters bring it up in economics and politics threads as a historical critique of austerity policy and the thinking behind it.

quote.text: There is some interesting (and somewhat relevant) commentary on historical thought about paying for government in Mark Blyth's talk at google
